script_text: Aries, money and desire collide this week, and ignoring the tension will cost you. Your fire-element confidence meets financial reality as ruling Mars now occupies Taurus, your 2nd House. Monday, Mercury in your 8th House squares Jupiter in your 3rd: verify every earnings claim before making a commitment. By Wednesday, that square loosens, shifting money talks from inflated promises to realistic, measurable terms. Friday’s 1st House Moon trines Jupiter in Leo, your 3rd, favoring referrals and quality income conversations. Saturday calls for boundaries, while Sunday’s Full Moon in your 1st opposes the 7th House Sun, clarifying love and shared money. Friday is your power day because the Moon–Jupiter trine supports profitable connections and clearer pricing. Monday is your worst day because Mercury–Jupiter’s square magnifies financial promises and avoidable career confusion. Ground your fire in evidence: read the numbers carefully, then speak. Follow for daily updates.
